descriptions.handle_event__15D16fChoicePanelP9D16fEve: Choice panel message handler: opens on message 64 (E_FAIL if the base handler fails) and closes on 66; otherwise, when its control is ready and idle, handles pointer picks (posting a selected-name message after an accepted point), the four entry-choice messages and cancel, forwards remaining or successful messages to the control, and finishes in the base handler.
